---
title: "DNAm_RNA_deconvolution_comparisons"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(glue)
library(readxl)
library(magrittr)

project_dir <- "~/Documents/repos/explant-seq"
dna_m_path <- glue("{project_dir}/data/DNA/DNA-methylation/2026-06-19/HiBED_deconvolution_260810.csv")
rna_path <- glue("{project_dir}/data/RNA/cibersort_res_job11_260609.csv")

dna_m <- read.csv(dna_m_path)
rna <- read.csv(rna_path)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- dna_m: reshape to long, already in percent (0-100) ---
dna_long <- dna_m %>%
  select(Sample_Name, Endothelial, Stromal, Astrocyte, Microglial,
         Oligodendrocyte, GABA, GLU) %>%
  rename(GABA_Inhibitory = GABA, GLU_Excitatory = GLU) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Sample_Name,
    names_to = "cell_type",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  mutate(dataset = "DNAm", sample_id = Sample_Name) %>%
  select(sample_id, dataset, cell_type, proportion)

# --- rna: reshape to long, convert fraction -> percent, drop Opc ---
rna_long <- rna %>%
  select(Mixture, Ex, Oli, In, Mic, Ast, End, Per) %>%  # Opc dropped
  rename(
    GLU_Excitatory   = Ex,
    Oligodendrocyte  = Oli,
    GABA_Inhibitory  = In,
    Microglial       = Mic,
    Astrocyte        = Ast,
    Endothelial      = End,
    Stromal          = Per
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Mixture,
    names_to = "cell_type",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = proportion * 100,   # fraction -> percent
    dataset = "RNA",
    sample_id = Mixture
  ) %>%
  select(sample_id, dataset, cell_type, proportion)

# --- combine ---
combined <- bind_rows(dna_long, rna_long) %>%
  mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = c(
    "Microglial", "Oligodendrocyte", "Astrocyte",
    "Endothelial", "Stromal", "GABA_Inhibitory", "GLU_Excitatory"
  )))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- Check + document zero cell types before dropping ---
combined %>%
  group_by(cell_type, dataset) %>%
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(proportion), max_prop = max(proportion), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(mean_prop < 0.01)

combined_filtered <- combined %>%
  filter(cell_type != "Astrocyte")

# --- Dataset colors ---
dataset_colors <- c("DNAm" = "#4274D9", "RNA" = "#00C68D")

summary_df <- combined_filtered %>%
  group_by(cell_type, dataset) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_prop = mean(proportion),
    se_prop   = sd(proportion) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

shared_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "right",
    legend.title     = element_blank(),
    plot.caption     = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey50"),
    axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11, face = "bold")
  )

p_bar <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = cell_type, y = mean_prop, fill = dataset)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.6,
           alpha = 0.6, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_prop - se_prop, ymax = mean_prop + se_prop),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_point(data = combined_filtered,
             aes(x = cell_type, y = proportion, colour = dataset, group = dataset),
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.8),
             size = 1, alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dataset_colors) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = dataset_colors) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion (%)", fill = "Dataset", colour = "Dataset",
       caption = "Astrocyte proportions were ~0% in both DNAm and RNA datasets and are omitted from this figure.") +
  shared_theme +
  coord_flip()

p_bar

ggsave(file="test.svg", plot=p_bar, width=7, height=4)
```
